snippet.title: Raiden III PS2 Gameplay HD (PCSX2)
snippet.description:
Raiden III PS2 Gameplay
Release Date: 22 September 2005 (JP); April 17, 2007 (NA) [PS2]
Platforms: PlayStation 2
_____________________________________________
NOTE: Interlacing (F5): Bob tff will make screen shaking (only on main menu) to stop the shaking set Interlacing to 'Auto'.
_____________________________________________
PCSX2 Settings:
Renderer: OpenGL (Hardware)
Interlacing (F5): Bob tff
Texture Filtering: Bilinear (PS2)
Internal Resolution: 8x Native
Anisotropic Filtering: 16x
Mipmapping: Basic (Fast)
CRC Hack Level: Automatic (Default)
_____________________________________________
My PC Specs:
CPU: Intel Core i7-4790K
GPU: GeForce GTX 1070
Ram: 16GB
OS: Microsoft Windows 10 Pro
_____________________________________________
Please leave a comment and rate it. :)
Enjoy !
